name: Temple Trained Priest
body:
You trained as an acolyte at a temple or shrine of your faith

Prerequisite: 1st character level in a class with divine spells as a class feature

Benefit: Knowledge (Religion) is always a class skill for you, and you receive a +2 bonus to Knowledge (Religion) checks (clerics and paladins receive a +3 bonus).
